topic: The Salton Sea: what Sentinel-2 shows
title: The Salton Sea: What Satellites Show (test topic)

notes.statement: The Salton Sea is shrinking mainly because less Colorado River water reaches it since the 2003 water transfers, according to a UC Riverside-led task force report, the Congressional Research Service and the Water Education Foundation.

source.outlet: UC Riverside Salton Sea Task Force / CRS / Water Education Foundation

notes.corroboration: three independent publishers describe the 2003 Quantification Settlement Agreement as the main driver

notes.statement: A Congressional Research Service report puts the drop in water surface elevation at about 10 feet since 2003.
The Imperial Valley Press reported that the sea's surface fell about 10 inches since August 2024.
NBC Palm Springs reported in September 2026 that an appeals court set back a Salton Sea lithium project.
notes.short: NBC: court set back lithium project

notes.statement: In a window over the southern shore, the number of water-like pixels fell from 42,022 in October 2022 to 33,784 in October 2026, about 20 percent fewer; the counts for 2024 and 2025 are 38,436 and 37,550.
Four Sentinel-2 scenes, all from the same orbit, taken between October 3 and October 31 in 2022, 2024, 2025 and 2026.
notes.short: Four scenes, same orbit, each October
